name: Economy 2: every supply at its maker's full effect (the idle market's upper bound on combat)
why: 55-review-economy change 1, interaction trace 5.1. If the refill fills from player-made stock, a hunter uses full-effect food, drinks, arrows and runes where it used the store's 75% copies. BASIC_EFFECT_SHARE 0.75 -> 1.0 is the most that can move pace and survival. Nothing is targeted: every moved band is the trace.
